channel.title: The Oakland Press - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Oakland Press (theoaklandpress.com)

item.title: ‘I can’t tell you’: Attorneys, relatives struggle to find hospitalized ICE detainees
item.description: Many hospitals refuse to provide information or allow contact with these patients.

item.title: Housing costs are crippling many Americans. Here’s how the two parties propose to fix that
item.description: A closer look at competing plans for expanding housing and reining in costs.

item.title: Why the Pistons are confident in building a championship team differently
item.description: The Detroit Pistons are different than most modern NBA teams. They’re just fine with that. It’s only Year 2 with coach J.B. Bickerstaff and president of basketball operations Trajan Langdon leading the franchise ahead, but their rapid rise to success is undeniable.

item.title: How trade for Maxx Crosby would impact Lions’ salary cap
item.description: Pro Bowl defensive end Maxx Crosby appears to have played his final snap as a member of the Las Vegas Raiders, and as a result could be wearing a new uniform in 2026.

item.title: How a California tribe is confronting the Trump administration to claim their historic rights to a river
item.description: As Pacific Gas and Electric Co., seeks to decommission its Potter Valley hydroelectric project, the Round Valley tribal coalition is confronting the Trump administration over the future of the Eel River.

item.title: Aday Mara scores 24 points and No. 2 Michigan routs rival Ohio State 82-61
item.description: Aday Mara scored a career-high 24 points, Morez Johnson Jr. and Yaxel Lendeborg had double-doubles and second-ranked Michigan rolled to an 82-61 victory over Ohio State on Sunday.

item.title: Lauren Betts leads No. 2 UCLA to 69-66 win over No. 8 Michigan, takes 2-game lead in Big Ten race
item.description: Lauren Betts had 16 points, 16 rebounds, five assists and three blocks to help No. 2 UCLA hold off No. 8 Michigan for a 69-66 win on Sunday.

item.title: Seahawks ride their ‘Dark Side’ defense to a Super Bowl title, pounding the Patriots 29-13
item.description: Defense won this championship. Devon Witherspoon, Derick Hall, Byron Murphy and the rest of Mike Macdonald’s ferocious unit pummeled Drake Maye, and the Seattle Seahawks beat the New England Patriots 29-13 on Sunday to win the franchise’s second Super Bowl.

item.title: QB Sam Darnold wins Super Bowl championship right where he revived his career with San Francisco
item.description: How fitting that Sam Darnold delivered the capstone of his topsy-turvy NFL career in the very same place where he recently revived it.

item.title: MSU’s Kenneth Walker III becomes 1st running back to win Super Bowl MVP in 28 years
item.description: MSU product Kenneth Walker III is running into free agency with a Super Bowl MVP. Walker capped a prolific postseason with another big performance on the ground to help the Seattle Seahawks beat the New England Patriots 29-13 Sunday night for a championship.
